mapper.sql:
pts AS ( SELECT ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(u.lot, u.lat), 4326), 5179) AS g, sum(u.cv) AS cv, sum(u.cd) AS cd FROM ( SELECT c.lat, c.lot, count(*) AS cv, 0 AS cd FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt c WHERE c.cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND c.lat IS NOT NULL AND c.ocrn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND c.ocrn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND c.emd_cd = #{emdCd} AND c.emd_cd LIKE #{sggCd} || '%' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT k.lat, k.lot, 0, count(*) FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn k WHERE k.lat IS NOT NULL AND k.crdn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND k.crdn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND k.emd_cd = #{emdCd} AND k.emd_cd LIKE #{sggCd} || '%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ) u GROUP BY 1 ), clustered AS ( SELECT g, cv, cd, ST_ClusterDBSCAN(g, eps := #{eps}, minpoints := #{minPoints}) OVER () AS cid FROM pts ), agg AS ( SELECT cid, sum(cv) AS cvlcpt_cnt, sum(cd) AS crdn_cnt, ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(g)) AS ctr, ceil(sqrt(GREATEST(ST_Area(ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(g))), 1))) AS box_m FROM clustered WHERE cid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cid ), maxed AS (
SELECT a.*, MAX(a.cvlcpt_cnt) OVER () AS max_cvlcpt_cnt, MAX(a.crdn_cnt) OVER () AS max_crdn_cnt FROM agg a )

LEFT( CASE WHEN nm.addr IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ad.emd_nm IS NULL THEN nm.addr WHEN nm.addr LIKE ad.emd_nm || '%' THEN nm.addr ELSE ad.emd_nm || ' ' || nm.addr END, 100) AS zone_nm, CASE WHEN nm.addr IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'CRDN_ADDR' END AS zone_nm_src

LEFT JOIN parking.tb_admdst ad ON ST_Contains(ad.bndry_geom, ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
SELECT r.addr FROM (SELECT regexp_replace(k.crdn_addr, '^제주특별자치도\s+((제주시|서귀포시)\s+)?', '') AS addr FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn k WHERE k.geom IS NOT NULL AND k.crdn_addr IS NOT NULL AND k.geom && ST_Transform(ST_Expand(t.ctr, t.box_m / 2 + 50), 4326) AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(k.geom, 5179), t.ctr, t.box_m / 2 + 50)) r WHERE r.addr <> '' AND r.addr !~ '^\S+(동|읍|면|리) 일대$' GROUP BY r.addr ORDER BY (r.addr ~ '[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$'), count(*) DESC, r.addr LIMIT 1 ) nm ON true
mapper.select:
WITH , wgted AS (
SELECT m.*, #{cvlcptWgt} * COALESCE(m.cvlcpt_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(m.max_cvlcpt_cnt, 0), 0) + #{crdnWgt} * COALESCE(m.crdn_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(m.max_crdn_cnt, 0), 0) AS wgted_vl FROM maxed m ), scored AS ( SELECT w.*, ROUND(COALESCE(w.wgted_vl / NULLIF(MAX(w.wgted_vl) OVER (), 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS snths_scr FROM wgted w ), ranked AS (
SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.snths_scr DESC) AS scr_rnk, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.snths_scr > 0) OVER () AS scr_cnt FROM scored s ), top AS (
SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.snths_scr DESC, r.cvlcpt_cnt DESC, r.cid) AS rnk FROM ranked r WHERE r.snths_scr > 0 AND r.scr_rnk <= CEIL(r.scr_cnt * #{maxRankPct} / 100.0) ORDER BY rnk LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT t.rnk, t.cvlcpt_cnt, t.crdn_cnt, t.snths_scr, t.scr_rnk, t.scr_cnt, ST_Y(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS mrk_lat, ST_X(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS mrk_lot, ad.emd_nm, ST_Y(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS ctr_lat, ST_X(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS ctr_lot,
FROM top t
ORDER BY t.rnk
mapper.sql: wts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trim_scale(v.pct) AS pct FROM (SELECT g.pct::numeric AS pct FROM generate_series(0, 100) AS g(pct) UNION SELECT #{cvlcptWgvl}::numeric ) v ), wgted AS ( SELECT w.pct, m.*, (w.pct / 100) * COALESCE(m.cvlcpt_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(m.max_cvlcpt_cnt, 0), 0) + (1 - w.pct / 100) * COALESCE(m.crdn_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(m.max_crdn_cnt, 0), 0) AS wgted_vl FROM maxed m CROSS JOIN wts w ), scored AS ( SELECT x.*, ROUND(COALESCE(x.wgted_vl / NULLIF(MAX(x.wgted_vl) OVER (PARTITION BY x.pct), 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS snths_scr FROM wgted x )
mapper.select:
WITH , , ranked AS ( SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.pct ORDER BY s.snths_scr DESC) AS scr_rnk, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.snths_scr > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY s.pct) AS scr_cnt FROM scored s ), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.cid FROM ranked r WHERE r.snths_scr > 0 AND r.scr_rnk <= CEIL(r.scr_cnt * #{maxRankPct} / 100.0) ), top AS ( SELECT a.* FROM agg a JOIN cand c ON c.cid = a.cid ) SELECT t.cid, t.cvlcpt_cnt, t.crdn_cnt, ST_Y(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS mrk_lat, ST_X(ST_Transform(t.ctr, 4326)) AS mrk_lot, ad.emd_nm,
FROM top t
ORDER BY t.cid

WITH , , cnt AS ( SELECT s.pct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.snths_scr > 0) AS scr_cnt FROM scored s GROUP BY s.pct ) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(a.cvlcpt_cnt), 0) FROM agg a) AS max_cvlcpt_cnt, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(a.crdn_cnt), 0) FROM agg a) AS max_crdn_cnt, w.pct AS cvlcpt_wgvl, COALESCE(c.scr_cnt, 0) AS scr_cnt FROM wts w LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.pct = w.pct ORDER BY w.pct

SELECT to_char(LEAST( (SELECT min(ocrn_dt) FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99'), (SELECT min(crdn_dt) FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn)), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_bgng_ymd, to_char(GREATEST((SELECT max(ocrn_dt) FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99'), (SELECT max(crdn_dt) FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn)), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_end_ymd
